name: 2. Smart Loan Advisor - Retrieval & RAG Chain Workflow (Visual Layout)

parameters.content:
## 📚 1. Grounded Context & Retrieval Flow
Retrieves grounded context (RBA cash rates, CDR customer loan profile, bank comparisons) and constructs prompt payload.

## 🛡️ 2. Model Inference, Guardrails & Response Flow
Executes local LLM inference via Ollama, runs 3-layer guardrail validation & Ragas quality evals, then returns verified output.
